title: Harbor Library synthetic service guide
notice: Authored for this repository. This is fictional public test data, not real service guidance.
pages: Membership and borrowing. Harbor Library membership is free for residents. Bring photo identification and proof of address to register. Books can be borrowed for twenty-one days. A member may renew a book twice unless another member has reserved it. A lost membership card costs three dollars to replace.

Hours and access. The library opens at 9 am Monday through Friday and closes at 6 pm. Saturday opening hours are 10 am to 4 pm. The building is closed on Sundays. Bicycle parking is next to the east entrance. The accessible entrance is on the west side beside the elevator.

Rooms and equipment. Study rooms may be reserved for up to two hours per day. Cancel a room reservation at least one hour before it begins. Black-and-white printing costs ten cents per page; color printing costs fifty cents per page. Laptops must be used inside the library and returned before closing. Staff do not provide passport appointments.
